summary: Markets held near record territory Thursday as the S&P 500 closed at an all-time high of 7,798.99, surpassing 7,800 intraday for the first time, while tech and energy led the rally. The advance came as traders digested July's CPI report showing headline inflation at 3.4% year-over-year with a modest 0.1% monthly increase, combined with weak July jobs data showing a 23,000 job loss that has dampened expectations for Fed rate hikes. Bitcoin ETFs saw volatility with $61.1 million in outflows on August 13 after strong weekly inflows earlier, while crypto prices traded mixed with BTC hovering around $63,400-64,200. Workday shares surged 26% on takeover talks with Silver Lake, oil prices slid over 2% to $81.25 per barrel amid U.S.-Iran tensions, and Friday's session ended with modest losses as University of Michigan consumer sentiment disappointed despite the S&P 500 capping its third straight weekly gain.

signals.title: S&P 500 hits record high above 7,800 as inflation data cools
signals.desc: The benchmark index notched an all-time closing high of 7,798.99 on Thursday as July CPI rose just 0.1% monthly, reducing pressure on the Fed to hike rates further.

signals.title: July jobs report misses badly with 23,000 job losses
signals.desc: The U.S. economy lost 23,000 jobs in July versus expectations for 80,000-95,000 gains, creating a policy dilemma for the Fed amid sticky 3.4% inflation.

signals.title: Workday surges 26% on Silver Lake takeover talks
signals.desc: Software company shares jumped after Reuters reported private equity firm Silver Lake is in discussions to acquire Workday, pushing the stock positive for 2026.

signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs post $61.1M outflow reversing strong weekly trend
signals.desc: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw outflows on August 13 with IBIT losing $14.3M and FBTC shedding $46.8M, despite earlier weekly inflows exceeding $850 million.

signals.title: Oil prices drop over 2% on demand concerns amid geopolitical tensions
signals.desc: WTI crude fell to $81.25 per barrel as traders weighed declining oil demand while the U.S.-Iran conflict continues, pressuring energy sector sentiment.

verdict: Equity momentum remains intact despite mixed macro signals, with record S&P 500 levels supported by cooling inflation offset by labor market weakness creating Fed uncertainty.
